question.text: Category III AIFs register with SEBI under which form?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.2.1, application is made in Form A along with non-refundable application fee. The Trap: Form B is the Registration Certificate; Forms C/Z don't apply. Cross-Exam Context: Tested across multiple sections. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Keep Form A templates and SEBI fees schedule handy for repeat launches.
